statements.t: “Achieving positive adjusted EBITDA a quarter ahead of our target is a monumental milestone and it reflects the discipline we have built across Blink over the past eighteen months.
We intend to build on this momentum and continue our trajectory of positive adjusted EBITDA.
We expect to maintain positive adjusted EBITDA through the fourth quarter of 2026.
The revised outlook primarily reflects the Company’s continued focus on revenue quality.

Looking ahead, the Company expects to return to revenue growth in 2027, driven by its evolving business model, expanding repeat and recurring revenue opportunities, and the strategic evolution into energy management solutions.
Battaglia will continue to serve as the Company’s Chief Executive Officer and, in connection with his appointment as Chairman, will no longer hold the title of President.

statements.t: Generally, these statements relate to business plans or strategies, projected or anticipated benefits or other consequences of our plans or strategies, projected or anticipated benefits from acquisitions to be made by us, or projections involving anticipated revenues, earnings or other aspects of our operating results.
Competition - The EV charging equipment and service market is highly competitive, and we expect the market to become increasingly competitive as new entrants enter this growing market.
If the market for EVs does not gain broad market acceptance or develops slower than we expect, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be adversely affected.
We have not yet achieved profitability and expect cash flows from operations to be volatile.
Historically, we have been able to raise funds to support our business operations, although there can be no assurance that we will be successful in raising significant additional funds in the future.

We expect that our cash on hand and future cash flows from operations will fund our operations for at least 12 months after the issuance date of the financial statements included in this Quarterly Report.
There is no assurance that we will be able to obtain funds on commercially acceptable terms, if at all.
